scripts.dev: sh -c 'pnpm --dir backend run start:dev & backend_pid=$!; trap "kill $backend_pid" EXIT INT TERM; until node -e "fetch(\"http://127.0.0.1:9000/\").then((res)=>process.exit(res.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))"; do sleep 1; done; pnpm --dir frontend dev'
scripts.dev:install: pnpm --dir frontend install && pnpm --dir backend install
